heading.title: Of the Duties of an Executor or Administrator

article.title: Save as aforesaid, all debts to be paid equally and rateably.
article.content:
323Save as aforesaid, all debts to be paid equally and rateably.

Section 323  ·  Part IX · Chapter VII  ·  page 85 of the Act
Save as aforesaid, no creditor shall have a right of priority over another; but the executor or administrator shall pay all such debts as he knows of, including his own, equally and rateably as far as the assets of the deceased will extend.
